text:
Maya: Quick reminder — release cutoff tomorrow 18:00 UTC. Please bump any submodule refs and refresh vendor/ lockfiles before cutoff. We'll cut branch `release/0.9.0` after the window. If you own repos with go modules, python deps, or vendored C libs, ping here with status. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Kevin: Is there an approved procedure for updating vendor/? I tried regenerating and CI failed on checksum mismatches. :confused:

Maya: For Go: run `make vendor-update` (wraps `go mod vendor` + checksum checks), then `git add vendor/ && git commit -m "vendor: bump deps"`. CI has a `ci/vendoring` job that validates checksums and ensures no unexpected changes. For python (poetry), run `poetry lock` then `poetry export -f requirements.txt --output vendor/requirements.txt` if we vendor deps.

Dorothy: Submodules: make sure to push the new pinned commit in the sub-repo first, then update the superproject with `git submodule update --remote <path>` or `git submodule set-branch` depending on workflow. I pushed `infra/logging-submod-bump` with the commit for the logging submodule — someone please update the superproject and open the PR.

Ben: Quick checklist to avoid last-minute noise: 1) bump submodule refs, 2) regenerate vendor, 3) run `make test-short` locally, 4) open PR against `main` (we'll cherry-pick into `release/*`) or directly target `release/0.9.0` if it's a release-critical fix, 5) add one-line changelog entry under `changelogs/unreleased/`. I'll review any vendor/submodule PRs before cutoff. :white_check_mark:

deps-bot: I ran `go mod tidy` on `service/rt-serve` and detected diffs in `vendor/github.com/*` — created PR #842 with the vendor updates.

Maya: Thanks @Ben and @deps-bot. Kevin — if your CI is flaky, paste the `ci/vendoring` log here and I'll take a look. If vendor churn blocks the release, we can revert the vendor PR and handle in a post-release patch unless it's a security fix.

Kevin: Pasted snippet from CI: ```
verifying vendor/github.com/some/dep@v1.2.3: checksum mismatch
Expected: h1:abcd...
Got: h1:efgh...
``` Fix locally with `GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go mod vendor` then commit vendor/ dir. Opening PR now.

Carla: One more request — avoid changing API surface or transitive proto versions in this window unless you coordinate with platform. Last time a tiny proto bump cascaded into doc + client changes. If it's not security-critical, please defer to post-release.

Maya: Agreed. If it's not an urgent security fix, defer. We'll run a final lockfile audit at 17:00 UTC and publish a final go/no-go.

Ben: I'll batch small vendor bumps into a single PR to reduce CI churn. Ping me @Ben when you're ready for review.

Kevin: Opened PR #867: vendor regen + submodule pin. Ran `make test-short` locally, all green. :shipit:

Dorothy: Merged the submodule update branch into my staging branch; will wait for the vendor PR to merge before opening the release PR.

Maya: Solid. If anyone needs help running vendoring commands or the submodule flow, DM me. I'll post the final status at 17:00 UTC. :hammer_and_wrench:
